Luigi Suigo is looking the part here at Villanova practice. Regularly hitting cutters off the high post. Taking and making 3’s. 7-3. Will regularly be a hub of the offense.
Villanova has two certified long range snipers off the bench in Buddy Simmons (St. Bonaventure) and Jake Fiegen (Cornell). Both should make 50 or more three-point shots in reserve. Dangerous duo.
Villanova’s physical makeup is completely different than it’s been the past 25 years. Bigger. Longer. Legitimate positional size. The Cats are huge across the board.
